title: The Main Event Mafia vs. the TNA Frontline
summary: Veteran stars demand respect and enforce it as the Main Event Mafia. AJ Styles and TNA’s younger wrestlers resist, although shifting loyalties complicate the battle between generations.

chapters.title: The veterans unite
chapters.result: The Main Event Mafia takes shape; Sting and Nash defeat Styles and Joe.
chapters.context: The veterans’ demand for respect becomes a coordinated attempt to control the promotion, provoking the TNA Frontline’s resistance.

chapters.title: Styles breaks the Mafia’s world-title hold
chapters.result: AJ Styles wins a five-way match over champion Angle, Sting, Matt Morgan and Hernandez.
chapters.context: Styles emerges with the world championship as Sting makes room for his younger ally’s breakthrough. The win weakens the Mafia’s claim to supremacy.
